description:
Gundam UC & Origin Flag Pack

By request from one of my Bluesky subscribers, I delved into the black hole of Gundam to create this flag pack. As Gundam is incredibly big, Flag pack only includes UC and Origin (as they seem connected).

One thing to note, there are a lot of flags, and I don't have unlimited time (and my priority on faction mod I developing) so pack aren't complete. But it will be updated over time to every faction listed under UC on Gundam Wiki which has anything to create flag from.

Also seems some flags are missing on Gundam Wiki faction page (https://gundam.fandom.com/wiki/Gundam_Wiki:Factions). So, if you know any what are not on factions' page from UC or Origin write about them here or contact me on Bluesky.

CURRENTLY IN THE PACK:

EARTH FEDERATION

ZEON

ORIGIN AND OTHERS

Disclaimer: I don't know any lore, if some of my designs don't fit the original themes, I welcome constructive feedback.

Change logs

Spoiler
29.07.25 - v0.35: Removed "weird" flag and expanded EF category with 10 new flags
